items.title: Shaam ka bazaar Abid-e-beemaar
items.body:
Shaam ka bazaar Abid-e-beemaar
Paaoun may bedi touq-e-giraan baar
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhoolega na woh manzar, naizay pay saray Sarwar
Bay maqna-o-bay chaadar, balway may phupi maadar
Aur majma-e-kuffaar Abid-e-beemaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Bazaar ki zeibaayi, kotthoun pay tamashaayi
Aada ki safaaraayi, aur aalam-e-tanhaayi
Woh bekas-o-laachaar Abid-e-beemaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Darbaar mai sar uryaan aathay hain haram giryaan
Uttney laga ek toofaan mehshar ka meher taabaan
Jumbish mai hai darbaar Abid-e-beemaar
Bu aayi tho ghabraa kar bachchi ney kaha rokar
Is tasht may hai jo sar woh toh hai sar-e-Sarwar
Kaise karoon deedaar Abid-e-beemaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Kuch Shimr say farmaado gardhan meri khulwaado
Sar Baba ka dilwaado ya usko yeh samjhaado
Maarey na sitamgaar Abid-e-beemaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Haakim ne yeh sunn paaya tho aur sitham dhaaya
Sar poush ka sarkaaya aur bachchi ko dikhlaaya
Chillaayi woh ek baar Abid-e-beemaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Dukhtar ki sadaa sunkar phir tasht-e-thilaa sey sar
Godhi mai gaya uttkar naadaan ney liptaakar
Sar par rakhe rukhsaar Abid-e-beemaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindaan may Anees-e-gham karthay hain haram maatam
Maa poochti hai paiham kyon aankh hai yeh purnam
Kya margayi dildaar Abid-e-beemaar

items.title: samere me ghul hai bapa haaye haaye
items.body:
samere me ghul hai bapa haaye haaye
askari ne ki hai qaza haaye haaye
kehte hai sar peet ke saahib zamaa'n
wa abata wa abata haaaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
zehre dagha se kiya zalim ne qatl
aapko be jurm o qata haaye haaye
ehle haram rote hai sar peet kar
warise mehboobe quda haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch na kiya paas imaame zamaa'n
baitul sharaf loot liya haaye haaye
hogaye bin baap ke sahib zamaa'n
waasafa waasafa haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
saaya e paake shahe hadi e hashr
momino ke sar se utha haaye haaye

items.title: Aye Sarware Zeeshaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
items.body:
Aye Sarware Zeeshaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
Aye Fatima ki Jaan Khuda hqfiz-o-Naser
Ab aglay baras hind may aap aayengay Aaqa
Jeetay rahey khaadim tho tumhey paaengayAaqa
Kuch sharth ghulaami ki bajaa laaengay Aaqa
Aye shiyoun ke mehmaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
<<MINI>>
Aye Sarware Zeeshaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
Aye Fatima ki Jaan Khuda hqfiz-o-Naser
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya taaziya khaanou may barasthi hai udaasi
Main tumpey fida aaj woh raunaq nahin kalki
Aawaaz yeh hai har dar-o-diwaar sey aathi
Aye deen ke sultaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
<<MINI>>
Aye Sarware Zeeshaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
Aye Fatima ki Jaan Khuda hqfiz-o-Naser
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye jaan-o-dil-e-Ahmad-e-Mukhtaar sidhaaro
Aye beykason ke qaafila salaar sidhaaro
Khaaliq ki amaan aye Shahey Abrar sidhaaro
Allah nigehbaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
<<MINI>>
Aye Sarware Zeeshaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
Aye Fatima ki Jaan Khuda hqfiz-o-Naser
<<DIVIDER>>
Aey Qasim waaye Akbar-e-jarraar sidhaaro
Aey Hazrat Abbas-e-Alamdaar sidhaaro
Aey ghunchadahan bano ke dildaar sidhaaro
Aey Asghar-e-nadaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
<<MINI>>
Aye Sarware Zeeshaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
Aye Fatima ki Jaan Khuda hqfiz-o-Naser
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab kaahey ko tashreef yahaan layegi Zehra
Ab kaahey ko yaan bazm-e-aza hoyegi barpaa
Ab kaahey ko yaan hoga azadaroun ka aana
Ghar hogaya sunsaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
<<MINI>>
Aye Sarware Zeeshaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
Aye Fatima ki Jaan Khuda hqfiz-o-Naser
<<DIVIDER>>
Ronay hi na paaye tujhey aye kushta-e-aada
Kya jald huva khatm teray gham ka zamaana
Dasveen hai Moharram ki bas ab ho chuka ashra
Baqir teray qurbaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
<<MINI>>
Aye Sarware Zeeshaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
Aye Fatima ki Jaan Khuda hqfiz-o-Naser
